opcode_tables.why_a_linear_walk_is_enough: an absent block-context opcode anywhere in the code proves the contract cannot read one on the dispatched path; a present one proves nothing, because the walk cannot attribute it to a selector. So the scan can grant independence and can never revoke it — which is why no site in this table is marked safe on the scan alone (§18's asymmetry)
